verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference. It covers workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions, and the CLI and MCP server built on it are described as doing everything the UI does. The OpenAPI probe 404 hit guessed paths, not the documented docs.jitsu.com/api reference, so it does not concretely contradict the claim. Missing for 10: the explicit UI-parity claim is made for the CLI rather than the HTTP API itself; no machine-fetchable OpenAPI spec was confirmed; no independent or hands-on corroboration of full API/UI parity.
